messages:
raj: trying to apply a terraform change to increase the shared gpu pool in us-west2; `terraform plan` is getting blocked by pre-merge policy. anyone seen this?

conftest-bot: PRE-MERGE CHECK FAILED (conftest)
Rule: freeze_window_protected_resource (deny)
Resource: google_compute_instance_group_manager.gpu-pool
Reason: changes to protected GPU pools are blocked during infra freeze window (weekly maintenance).

Details:
```
Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy
~ resource "google_compute_instance_group_manager" "gpu-pool" {
    target_size: 50 => 60  # blocked by policy
}

conftest: Policy violation: freeze_window_protected_resource - change denied
```

marta: this is expected — we're in the infra freeze window until 18:00 UTC today. that conftest rule intentionally blocks pool size changes to avoid noisy scaling during freeze. :lock:

raj: got it. this change is just for an internal perf experiment (e2e), not prod. i don't want to wait but also don't want to bypass policies. any suggestions?

sam: we shouldn't touch the shared pool during freeze. option: create an ephemeral spot GPU pool in the staging project/namespace and run the perf test there. that'll avoid touching shared resources and the policy. i can help wire it up.

elaine: FYI finance noticed GPU spend uptick last week — if we spin up extra capacity please add a cost center tag and a TTL. cost will ask otherwise.

raj: i can add tags and a TTL. does conftest block resources in staging too? or only protected shared pools?

conftest-bot: Policy check: freeze_window_protected_resource applies to resources with label `shared=true` or name matching `gpu-pool` pattern. New resources in `staging-*` are allowed.

infra-oncall: quick procedural note: if this was truly urgent and required changing protected resources, we accept exceptions via the ops-exception flow. create a PR, add label `exception:conftest` with reason + duration, ping @infra-oncall and include a rollback plan. exceptions are rare.

sam: i'll open a WIP PR that creates `gpu-staging-spot` with 6 gpus and TTL=4h, include cost tags. @marta can you review for k8s/helm parts?

marta: yep, happy to. please include the env-drift test in the job so we don't surprise clusters.

raj: thanks all — i'll pivot to staging pool approach and close this thread once PR is up. planning to include this snippet in the PR description for audit: 
```
# terraform snippet to create ephemeral pool
resource "google_compute_instance_group_manager" "gpu-staging-spot" {
  name        = "gpu-staging-spot"
  target_size = 6
  labels = { cost_center = "eng-experiments", ttl = "4h" }
}
```

sam: sounds good. tag me when it's ready and i'll handle quota check + cloud support case if needed. :thumbsup:

raj: will do — thanks everyone.
thread_text: terraform plan blocked by conftest during freeze window; discussed ephemeral staging pool workaround, exception process, cost tagging, and next steps
